mode.title: Mode
mode.description: Complaints returns one row per owner complaint with the full narrative. Component trends rolls them up per failing part and flags the ones no recall covers.

make.title: Make
make.description: Vehicle manufacturer, for example Ford, Honda, Tesla.

model.title: Model
model.description: Model name, for example Explorer or F-150. NHTSA stores some models only as body-style entries such as "F-150 SUPER CREW", and rejects the plain name outright. Type the plain name: the variants are found and merged for you, with duplicates removed.

yearFrom.title: From model year
yearFrom.description: Earliest model year. Set this alone to do a single year.

yearTo.title: To model year
yearTo.description: Latest model year. Leave empty to use the same year as above. Up to 60 years per run.

minSeverity.title: Minimum severity
minSeverity.description: Severity comes from what the owner reported: a death, an injury, a fire, or a crash. Most complaints report none of these, which is a real finding rather than missing data.

components.title: Components
components.description: Filter to specific failing parts as NHTSA names them, for example POWER TRAIN, ENGINE, ELECTRICAL SYSTEM, AIR BAGS. Leave empty for all of them.

dateFrom.title: From incident date
dateFrom.description: Earliest date the failure happened, as YYYY-MM-DD. Filters run on the incident date, not the filing date: owners often report months or years late, so filing dates would put old failures in recent buckets.

includeRecallCheck.title: Check recalls
includeRecallCheck.description: Fetch recalls for the same vehicle and mark whether any covers each complaint's component. Turning this off leaves the recall fields empty rather than false, so absence stays distinct from a real no.

includeSummary.title: Include owner narrative
includeSummary.description: The owner's description of what happened. Long, and the most useful field if you are reading rather than counting.

newOnly.title: Monitor mode: new complaints only
newOnly.description: Remember complaints already returned and emit only ones filed since. Run it weekly on the models you care about. Quiet runs cost nothing.
